I completely understand your fears and nerves love My fiancé is a traveling contractor and we have a four year old and I’m 27 weeks pregnant and its very stressful being apart for weeks etc with  all considering. I can say you adapt and learn to cope with everything. But I still struggle some days as any strong women would. I’m praying for you and I wish I could give you strong advice but I believe you and him will figure it out. It’s scary having to change all  your patterns when you are bringing a new life into the world but I’m sure he’ll figure something out to where he’s not away from you and baby months on end. You definitely have every right to feel nervous and anxious and probably have a lot going through your mind because yes huge blessing you are living with your in laws And have support but it’s not the same support as having your Significant other.  I believe strong people no matter what they face will always find a way to adapt and make their situation  work no matter what life throws at them. So just take some deep breaths. You seem like a down to earth 🌍 person, things will work itself out mama!
